purpose: Authoritative locality features used only when a reviewed current-reality locality is absent from the pinned Natural Earth populated-place snapshot. Every supplement must preserve explicit institutional provenance and must never be synthesized from an approximate map position.

uk-pcgn-equatorial-guinea-2026.title: Equatorial Guinea: Toponymic Factfile
uk-pcgn-equatorial-guinea-2026.note: The official factfile lists Ciudad de la Paz as the administrative centre of Djibloho at 01°35′33″N 10°49′25″E, states that the settlement was formerly known as Oyala, and records its January 2026 capital status.
